Grafschaft Bentheim.et: Literally, “County of Bentheim”, named after the historical County of Bentheim within the Holy Roman Empire. German districts are not called counties/Grafschaften; this is the only district with that word in the name.

s: an island in the river Rhine (between Rolandswerth and Bad Honnef) in North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
Grafenwerth.et:
By surface analysis, Graf (“count”) + -en- + Werth (“river island”).
The modern name came into use in the early 19th century.
Prior to that, the island was locally known as Mittelwerth, Graff or Groff.
